title: Capability ledger — what operators can turn off

pii_detection_enabled.runtime: Redis firewall:config:{org}.pii_detection_enabled MUST be present including JSON false
pii_detection_enabled.gateway: proxy_chat reads org_config; missing key defaults True (PIPELINE-0032 floor for old payloads)
pii_detection_enabled.off_means: built-in input PII floor does not redact/block maskable PII

output_pii_enabled.note: Independent of input pii_detection_enabled. L01-3 is the input content rule.

integrity_cannot_be_disabled_by_content_: org-scoped key vs URL/JWT org (403 org_scope)
firewall_enabled service switch is NOT the L01-3 content rule
signed_residuals: AKIA / aws_access_key lives in PII_PATTERNS (threat_type=pii). PII OFF can forward AWS-key-shaped input unless a secret/credential detector also matches.
CISO/org keyword policies may still match SSN independently of the PII floor. L01-3 pass criterion is the platform floor, not zero policy matches.
get_config may inherit default-org Redis if org key missing. Live proof must use org-keyed chat after PUBLISH, not GET-after-PUT alone.
